title: Section 9 restricted models, semantic oracles, and learned artifacts
description: Development-only typings for the nine restricted model and semantic-oracle mechanisms in Section 9 of the v4 mechanism census.

artifactTypes.label: Native opaque sRGB8 raster
artifactTypes.description: The once-decoded, native-dimension, three-channel opaque 8-bit sRGB raster with no resampling.
sourceNotes: This is the fixed left product anchor and the NativeRaster output in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:82-96.
provenanceNotes: Native dimensions, pixel order, source hash, and decode identity remain available through paired custody metadata.

artifactTypes.label: VLM oracle-normalized raster
artifactTypes.description: A development-only raster resized and normalized exactly for a pinned VLM oracle arm.
sourceNotes: Section 9 requires the image normalized under the oracle policy rather than silently treating the native raster as model input.
provenanceNotes: The preprocessing policy, source dimensions, processed dimensions, and hashes remain attached; this raster is prohibited from product inference.

artifactTypes.label: Pinned VLM bundle
artifactTypes.description: The exact VLM weights, revision, quantization, runtime, and model-family identity used by an oracle arm.
sourceNotes: Section 9 makes the model and revision an effective oracle input.
provenanceNotes: Warm VLM inference is prohibited at cold runtime; this bundle grants no semantic or product authority.

artifactTypes.label: Pinned VLM tokenizer
artifactTypes.description: The exact tokenizer and revision paired with a VLM arm, including the interface used by grammar masking.
sourceNotes: Grammar support is tokenizer-specific and cannot be inherited from another model arm.
provenanceNotes: The tokenizer is a prohibited-runtime learned-artifact input, not a hidden implementation default.

artifactTypes.label: VLM oracle preprocessing policy
artifactTypes.description: The pinned decode, resize, orientation, color, and normalization policy that produces a VLM oracle raster.
sourceNotes: Section 9 conditions VLM observations on an oracle-normalized image.
provenanceNotes: This research configuration is explicit and prohibited from silently replacing native-raster custody.

artifactTypes.label: Ordered closed-question VLM prompt
artifactTypes.description: The frozen ordered prompt and structural question set for ground, texture, enclosure, geometry, subjects, and marks.
sourceNotes: Prompt wording and order are load-bearing inputs in Section 9.
provenanceNotes: The exact bytes, order, revision, and hash must be retained for development-only oracle use.

artifactTypes.label: Closed-vocabulary VLM answer schema
artifactTypes.description: The frozen response schema and closed vocabularies associated with the ordered structural questions.
sourceNotes: The schema is separate from both prompt text and any model answer.
provenanceNotes: Schema validity constrains representation only and supplies no semantic truth.

artifactTypes.label: VLM closed-question decoding policy
artifactTypes.description: The frozen seed, decoding, attempt-bound, and deterministic execution policy for closed-question VLM inference.
sourceNotes: Section 9 explicitly names seed and decoding policy as VLM inputs.
provenanceNotes: This policy is frozen for an instrument run and has no product-selection authority.

artifactTypes.label: VLM closed-question answer records
artifactTypes.description: One closed-vocabulary model answer per frozen structural question, with the model note retained as a development hypothesis.
sourceNotes: Section 9 limits these records to development stratification.
provenanceNotes: Answers are not truth, reviewed labels, field ownership, role ownership, or runtime features.

artifactTypes.label: VLM oracle inference provenance
artifactTypes.description: Full source, preprocessing, model, tokenizer, prompt, schema, seed, decoding, timing, and attempt provenance for an oracle response.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Audit and reproduce prohibited-runtime VLM instrument observations.
sourceNotes: Section 9 requires full provenance with every closed-question label record.
provenanceNotes: Provenance establishes observation identity, not semantic correctness or a selected binding.

artifactTypes.label: Structured-decoding VLM prompt
artifactTypes.description: The exact prompt bytes supplied to the grammar-constrained VLM instrumentation attempt.
sourceNotes: The structured-output mechanism names prompt as a separate input.
provenanceNotes: Prompt bytes and hash remain arm-specific and development-only.

artifactTypes.label: VLM grammar JSON schema
artifactTypes.description: The exact JSON Schema compiled into tokenizer-specific logits constraints and used for response validation.
sourceNotes: Section 9 distinguishes schema enforcement from semantic correctness.
provenanceNotes: Schema and hash are explicit research inputs; a valid instance is not a truthful answer.

artifactTypes.label: VLM grammar decoding and retry policy
artifactTypes.description: The frozen grammar mode, greedy decoding settings, validation rule, changed-input retry rule, and bounded attempt count.
sourceNotes: Section 9 permits changed-input validate-and-retry only as the fallback when grammar is absent.
provenanceNotes: Retrying unchanged greedy input is excluded; this policy remains prohibited at palette runtime.

artifactTypes.label: Grammar-valid typed VLM response
artifactTypes.description: A VLM response that is syntactically valid against the pinned grammar schema, retained separately from semantic answer records.
sourceNotes: This artifact records mechanical structured-output success only.
provenanceNotes: Grammar validity does not establish semantic correctness, truth, role, or field ownership.

artifactTypes.label: VLM grammar failed-attempt ledger
artifactTypes.description: A bounded ledger of malformed, schema-invalid, unsupported-grammar, or exhausted structured-decoding attempts.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Audit structured-decoding failures without manufacturing an answer.
sourceNotes: Section 9 requires a bounded failed-attempt state when typed JSON is not produced.
provenanceNotes: Failure is retained explicitly and is never coerced into a semantic label.

artifactTypes.label: Frozen VLM wording variant
artifactTypes.description: One independently frozen prompt wording for the same construct, question order, model, images, schema, and decoding conditions.
sourceNotes: Section 9 compares two wording variants while intending to hold construct and order fixed.
provenanceNotes: Each variant carries independent bytes, revision, and hash and remains prohibited at runtime.

artifactTypes.label: VLM inter-prompt disagreement diagnostic
artifactTypes.description: Per-question agreement, kappa, binary disagreement, and the concordant subset for two frozen wording variants, with no forced aggregate.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Expose prompt sensitivity for development stratification and evidence interpretation.
sourceNotes: Section 9 treats disagreement as more informative than near-constant model self-confidence.
provenanceNotes: Agreement and concordance can reflect shared model habits and are not truth or corpus authority.

artifactTypes.label: SAM model-normalized raster
artifactTypes.description: A development-only raster transformed exactly for the pinned Segment Anything stack while retaining native-source correspondence.
sourceNotes: The model-facing raster is explicit rather than hidden inside SAM execution.
provenanceNotes: Resampling and normalization provenance are required; this raster is prohibited from cold palette inference.

artifactTypes.label: Pinned SAM stack
artifactTypes.description: The exact SAM weights, revision, runtime, prompt encoders, mask head, and dependency versions used by the instrument.
sourceNotes: Section 9 conditions determinism and output on the pinned SAM stack.
provenanceNotes: The stack is prohibited at cold runtime under current cost and accuracy evidence.

artifactTypes.label: SAM preprocessing policy
artifactTypes.description: The pinned decode, resize, coordinate-remapping, color, tensor, and normalization policy used by the SAM stack.
sourceNotes: SAM output is stack- and preprocessing-specific.
provenanceNotes: The policy and coordinate transforms are explicit development inputs, not runtime defaults.

artifactTypes.label: SAM prompt set
artifactTypes.description: Pinned point, box, text, or object prompts supplied as controls to candidate-mask generation.
sourceNotes: Section 9 permits several explicit SAM prompt modes.
provenanceNotes: These are supplied instrument controls, not produced semantic ground-point hypotheses or role labels.

artifactTypes.label: SAM mask cut and selection policy
artifactTypes.description: The pinned score cuts, nonmaximum suppression, per-prompt selection, ordering, cap, and no-mask rules for candidate masks.
sourceNotes: Section 9 names cut and selection policy as an effective mask-generation input.
provenanceNotes: Thresholds and ordering are retained with the prohibited-runtime instrument.

artifactTypes.label: SAM candidate masks
artifactTypes.description: Prompt-associated candidate masks emitted by the pinned SAM stack without semantic purity or role authority.
sourceNotes: Section 9 limits SAM masks to visualizing subject, text, and mark hypotheses.
provenanceNotes: A mask containing its prompt point or text does not establish semantic purity, field ownership, role, or truth.

artifactTypes.label: SAM candidate mask scores
artifactTypes.description: Model scores associated one-for-one with SAM candidate masks under the pinned stack and cut policy.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Inspect model scoring behavior alongside candidate masks.
sourceNotes: Section 9 requires scores among SAM outputs.
provenanceNotes: Model confidence is not semantic purity and cannot authorize a mask.

artifactTypes.label: SAM prompt-to-mask provenance
artifactTypes.description: Source, model, preprocessing, prompt, cut, selection, timing, and candidate correspondence for a SAM invocation.
sourceNotes: Section 9 requires prompt provenance with masks and scores.
provenanceNotes: Provenance preserves reproducibility but does not create a tested downstream binding.

artifactTypes.label: SAM explicit no-mask state
artifactTypes.description: An explicit development state recording that no candidate mask survived or was emitted for the supplied prompt set.
sourceNotes: Section 9 forbids silently replacing an absent SAM mask with a forced candidate.
provenanceNotes: No-mask is an instrument result, not evidence that the prompted concept is absent from the image.

artifactTypes.label: SAM residual subtraction cuts
artifactTypes.description: The frozen mask categories, confidence cuts, union behavior, overlap handling, and subtraction policy used to form a residual.
sourceNotes: Section 9 makes subtraction cuts explicit inputs to the tested residual rule.
provenanceNotes: The cuts define a research-only prior and cannot confer semantic field ownership.

artifactTypes.label: SAM field-enriched residual raster
artifactTypes.description: A development-only native-correspondence raster with selected SAM subject, text, and mark supports removed or masked.
sourceNotes: The tested residual was falsified as a pure-background isolator and retained only as field-enriched evidence.
provenanceNotes: This raster is synthesized diagnostic evidence, not source truth, publishable pixels, or runtime field ownership.

artifactTypes.label: SAM field-enriched residual mask
artifactTypes.description: The complement support left after the configured union of selected SAM masks is subtracted.
sourceNotes: The mask records the tested subtraction result rather than declaring pure field.
provenanceNotes: Residual support can retain secondary objects, text, and ornaments and has no field or role authority.

artifactTypes.label: SAM residual contamination causes
artifactTypes.description: Question-scoped contamination attributions such as unnamed objects, residual text, ornaments, and subtraction misses.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Explain residual-purity failures in the scoped SAM experiment.
sourceNotes: Section 9 retains contamination causes alongside the residual.
provenanceNotes: Attributions remain review-scoped diagnostics and are not runtime labels.

artifactTypes.label: SAM residual purity review
artifactTypes.description: The scoped forced-choice purity review and qualification record for a SAM subtraction residual.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Retain the reviewed residual-purity evidence and its ambiguity qualifications.
sourceNotes: Section 9 reports a 0.24 reweighted pure-field rate against a 0.75 bar.
provenanceNotes: The review supports the scoped falsification and does not assign runtime field ownership to individual residuals.

artifactTypes.label: Unresolved ground-point hypotheses
artifactTypes.description: One or more externally supplied image-coordinate hypotheses for the compositional ground, with no producer typed in this fragment.
sourceNotes: Section 9 names point hypotheses as inputs to the tested point-to-SAM route.
provenanceNotes: No mechanism here produces these hypotheses; their pointing-model origin remains an explicit unresolved root and is prohibited at runtime.

artifactTypes.label: SAM containing-mask route policy
artifactTypes.description: The frozen policy selecting a SAM mask that contains the supplied ground point.
sourceNotes: This is one of the three separately evaluated point-to-SAM growth policies.
provenanceNotes: The route is a prohibited-runtime research configuration and has no preferred-producer implication.

artifactTypes.label: SAM ground-ranked route policy
artifactTypes.description: The frozen policy ranking SAM candidates for ground before selecting the point-associated wash.
sourceNotes: This is one of the three separately evaluated point-to-SAM growth policies.
provenanceNotes: Ground ranking is policy, not truth, and remains prohibited at runtime.

artifactTypes.label: SAM union route policy
artifactTypes.description: The frozen policy unioning eligible SAM candidates into a point-associated wash.
sourceNotes: This is one of the three separately evaluated point-to-SAM growth policies.
provenanceNotes: Union behavior is policy, not field ownership, and remains prohibited at runtime.

artifactTypes.label: Ground-point localization verdict
artifactTypes.description: The scoped dot-right evaluation of supplied ground-point hypotheses, kept separate from mask-growth evaluation.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Preserve the supported point-localization result independently of failed SAM growth.
sourceNotes: Section 9 reports dot-right passing 13 of 16.
provenanceNotes: The verdict is scoped experiment evidence and does not resolve the missing point producer or authorize runtime points.

artifactTypes.label: SAM point-route selected wash
artifactTypes.description: The candidate wash selected or unioned by exactly one tested point-to-SAM route policy.
sourceNotes: The wash is retained separately from both generic SAM candidates and residual subtraction masks.
provenanceNotes: The tested growth routes were falsified; this mask is not ground truth, field ownership, or a runtime field mask.

artifactTypes.label: Point-to-SAM route verdict
artifactTypes.description: The policy-specific both-right counts, bar comparison, duplicate-noise qualification, and route conclusion.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Retain the falsified ground-mask-route evidence by policy.
sourceNotes: Section 9 separates successful pointing from failed mask growth and records duplicate-image response noise.
provenanceNotes: This verdict does not select another mask producer or imply a runtime route.

artifactTypes.label: Offline development corpus files
artifactTypes.description: The exact encoded files and corpus membership used only for embedding, duplicate, coverage, and holdout diagnostics.
sourceNotes: Section 9 names offline corpus files as global-embedding inputs.
provenanceNotes: Corpus membership and file hashes are development custody; runtime corpus lookup and per-file matching are prohibited.

artifactTypes.label: Embedding-model-normalized raster
artifactTypes.description: A development-only whole-image raster transformed under the selected embedding arm's pinned preprocessing policy.
sourceNotes: The model-facing corpus raster is explicit and retains crop, resize, center, and normalization behavior.
provenanceNotes: This raster is a prohibited-runtime model input and does not replace native source custody.

artifactTypes.label: Pinned global embedding model bundle
artifactTypes.description: The exact DINO- or CLIP-family weights, revision, runtime, processor, and code identity for one embedding arm.
sourceNotes: Section 9 conditions offline descriptors on the selected model arm.
provenanceNotes: Per-file inference with this learned bundle is prohibited at runtime.

artifactTypes.label: Global embedding model-arm configuration
artifactTypes.description: The pinned arm tag, model/processor pairing, resize and crop behavior, center handling, normalization, pooling, precision, batching, and L2-normalization policy.
sourceNotes: The model arm is an explicit Section 9 input rather than an incidental model default.
provenanceNotes: Configuration identity is frozen for offline comparison and grants no runtime authority.

artifactTypes.label: Embedding neighbor and clustering policy
artifactTypes.description: The pinned similarity, near-duplicate threshold, graph component, coverage clustering, seed, center initialization, tie, and strata policy.
sourceNotes: Section 9 reports an incomplete 0.95 near-duplicate graph and arm-dependent coverage organization.
provenanceNotes: Thresholds, seeds, initial centers, and tie behavior are explicit development inputs, not a corpus truth definition.

artifactTypes.label: L2-normalized global image embeddings
artifactTypes.description: One arm-tagged L2-normalized global descriptor vector per offline corpus file.
sourceNotes: Section 9 supports these descriptors only for bounded offline diagnostics.
provenanceNotes: Vectors mix subject, layout, and palette and are neither truth nor runtime palette features.

artifactTypes.label: Embedding nearest-neighbor graph
artifactTypes.description: The arm- and policy-specific similarity graph over offline corpus descriptors.
sourceNotes: Section 9 emits a nearest-neighbor graph as a development corpus diagnostic.
provenanceNotes: Edges are model similarities, not identity truth or tested runtime correspondences.

artifactTypes.label: Embedding near-duplicate components
artifactTypes.description: Connected components induced by the pinned near-duplicate similarity threshold, retained separately from embedding vectors and coverage clusters.
sourceNotes: Section 9 describes likely rendition or duplicate components and measured the 0.95 graph as incomplete.
provenanceNotes: Components are thresholded model hypotheses, not duplicate truth and never a runtime corpus lookup.

artifactTypes.label: Embedding coverage strata
artifactTypes.description: Arm-specific corpus cluster and coverage-stratum assignments used to organize development coverage.
sourceNotes: Section 9 notes that holdout and coverage sets depend on the selected embedding arm.
provenanceNotes: Strata organize development review only and are not semantic classes or runtime labels.

artifactTypes.label: Global embedding run provenance
artifactTypes.description: Corpus, file, model, version, hash, preprocessing, arm, vector, neighbor, clustering, and reviewer-exposure provenance.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Audit offline embedding, duplicate, and coverage diagnostics.
sourceNotes: Section 9 requires model, version, and hash provenance and warns about gallery exposure.
provenanceNotes: The record preserves data-firewall context and does not authorize corpus-derived runtime behavior.

artifactTypes.label: DINO CLS and all patch tokens
artifactTypes.description: The complete per-image DINO forward-pass activations containing the CLS token and every patch token before pooling.
sourceNotes: Section 9 says existing stored vectors are insufficient because these patch tokens were discarded.
provenanceNotes: This prohibited-runtime activation artifact must remain paired with its raster, model, and preprocessing identities.

artifactTypes.label: DINO CLS plus mean-patch pooling policy
artifactTypes.description: The frozen policy that averages all patch tokens, concatenates that mean with CLS, emits 2048 dimensions, and applies declared normalization.
sourceNotes: Section 9 proposes this exact pooling rule as a separately tagged bake-off arm.
provenanceNotes: The rule is unmeasured and prohibited for per-file runtime inference.

artifactTypes.label: DINO CLS plus mean-patch embedding
artifactTypes.description: One separately tagged 2048-dimensional pooled vector per image from CLS concatenated with the mean of all patch tokens.
sourceNotes: This proposed vector remains distinct from the existing global-embedding contract and has no local measurement yet.
provenanceNotes: The vector is not an adopted arm, duplicate component, semantic truth, or runtime feature.

artifactTypes.label: DINO pooling bake-off arm record
artifactTypes.description: A separate arm tag tying corpus, preprocessing, model, all-token forward pass, pooling rule, dimensions, hashes, and run identity together.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Prevent an unmeasured pooling arm from being confused with existing embedding evidence.
sourceNotes: Section 9 requires a new separately tagged bake-off arm.
provenanceNotes: Tagging does not adopt the arm or rewrite existing duplicate, holdout, coverage, or gallery evidence.

artifactTypes.label: Depth-model-normalized raster
artifactTypes.description: A development-only raster transformed exactly for a pinned pretrained monocular depth model.
sourceNotes: The proposed depth route requires a model-specific image rather than silently consuming native pixels.
provenanceNotes: Resizing and normalization are explicit and prohibited at runtime; no depth model has been run in this repository.

artifactTypes.label: Pinned monocular depth model bundle
artifactTypes.description: The exact pretrained depth weights, revision, processor, runtime, output convention, and calibration identity proposed for evaluation.
sourceNotes: Section 9 leaves the depth model unselected and unrun.
provenanceNotes: Any pretrained depth bundle is a prohibited-runtime research input and carries no compositional-ground authority.

artifactTypes.label: Monocular depth preprocessing policy
artifactTypes.description: The exact decode, resize, crop or center behavior, normalization, coordinate remapping, and output-resampling policy for a depth arm.
sourceNotes: The unbuilt depth route must expose model preprocessing as an effective input.
provenanceNotes: This policy is development-only and cannot silently alter native-source evidence.

artifactTypes.label: Depth evidence diagnostic policy
artifactTypes.description: The pinned relative-depth convention, confidence handling, uniformity and edge measures, thresholds, and out-of-domain test protocol.
sourceNotes: Section 9 proposes uniformity, edge, confidence, and explicit out-of-domain diagnostics.
provenanceNotes: Thresholds are unmeasured research inputs and cannot convert depth into field truth.

artifactTypes.label: Monocular relative-depth field
artifactTypes.description: A dense model-relative depth estimate with no metric scale and no compositional-ground interpretation.
sourceNotes: Section 9 externally disfavors using relative depth to identify compositional ground.
provenanceNotes: Confident structure can be wrong on printed pictures and flat graphics; this field is not truth, ownership, or a runtime field.

artifactTypes.label: Monocular depth confidence field
artifactTypes.description: An optional model-specific confidence or uncertainty field aligned to the relative-depth output.
sourceNotes: Section 9 makes confidence optional because depth models do not share one confidence contract.
provenanceNotes: Model confidence cannot establish correct geometry, compositional ground, or runtime authority.

artifactTypes.label: Depth uniformity and edge diagnostics
artifactTypes.description: Declared distributions and summaries of relative-depth uniformity, discontinuities, and alignment to image edges.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Evaluate the proposed photo-versus-flat and ground/figure depth claims.
sourceNotes: Section 9 proposes these diagnostics but reports no local depth run.
provenanceNotes: Uniformity and edges are model evidence only and do not assign a field, figure, identity, or role.

artifactTypes.label: Monocular depth out-of-domain test
artifactTypes.description: An explicit test record for whether the pretrained depth premise applies to stylized covers, printed pictures, or flat graphics.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Expose domain failure instead of forcing relative depth into semantic evidence.
sourceNotes: Section 9 requires an explicit out-of-domain test and notes only 4 of 30 hard covers depicted a place with depth.
provenanceNotes: An in-domain result would still not establish compositional-ground truth or runtime admissibility.

outputPorts.label: Residual purity review

notes: Review supports the scoped falsification and never becomes runtime ownership data.

mechanismTypings.title: Point localization followed by mask growth

source.headingText: ### `model.point-to-sam-ground` - Point localization followed by mask growth

censusStatus.authorizationText: `inventory-only`; this census entry grants no selection, composition, funding, or product authority.
censusStatus.statusText: scientific interpretation `supported` for point localization and `falsified` for the tested ground-mask route; implementation state `instrument`; evidence scope `isolated-semantic`; runtime admissibility `prohibited`.

notes: Exactly one of the three tested containing, ground-ranked, or union policies defines an invocation.

inputPorts.label: Native image
notes: Provides the image coordinate frame for point and mask review.

inputPorts.label: Ground-point hypotheses
notes: The point producer is intentionally unresolved; this mechanism does not manufacture or own the hypotheses.

inputPorts.label: SAM candidate masks
notes: Candidate compatibility does not bind this route to a mask producer.

inputPorts.label: Containing-mask policy
notes: Selects the tested containing-mask route when present.

inputPorts.label: Ground-ranked policy
notes: Selects the tested ground-ranked route when present.

inputPorts.label: Union policy
notes: Selects the tested union route when present.

outputPorts.label: Point localization verdict
valueStateNotes: Records dot-right independently of whether the selected wash is right.
notes: Keeps the supported pointer finding distinct from the falsified mask-growth route.

outputPorts.label: Policy-selected SAM wash
valueStateNotes: Absent when the chosen policy cannot produce an eligible wash; otherwise retains the exact selected or union mask.
notes: The wash is neither a generic SAM candidate set nor a residual mask, and it has no field authority.

outputPorts.label: Point-to-SAM route verdict
